title: Starting personal management with Dizzy Gillespie
summary: Teaching led to managing; Dizzy gave him a year, and Thomas advised Dizzy to go to England first as a single.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So after you went into teaching, after you left teaching, you went into personal management, huh, Foots?

Yeah. Let me tell you how that happened. See, by being involved in the teaching, I got involved with personal management. I remember one of the first groups I got was Bill Davis. I used to go down to Atlantic City... And one of the first guys that I had a personal management on was Dizzy. You know, I liked Dizzy, so I talked to him and he just gave me a year...

A year. I got a year of personal management work. And the first time he went to England, he went as a single. I said, 'Man, it's a good deal. Go on over there as a single.' So the next time they wanted him to come, he got a chance to take his whole group. It was on account of
he made so much noise over there as a single. He had a great group. He had this boy Joe in there, that did the singing...
